searchText: We plan to shut down devnet 9 today at noon UTC. Please yell if you would like to have devnet 9 up longer than that. Devnet 10 will stick around till Monday at noon UTC. will there be any running devnets after that, or is the plan to start focusing on more longer-lived/public testnets? TLDR from ACD: - Devnet-9 turns off today - Devnet-10 turns off monday - Devnet-11: small scale, with mev and long term comes online early next week - Goerli shadow fork: comes online early next week, lives for under a week mostly Teku, lodestar, prysm and lighthouse have all had mev blocks produced on devnet-10 with blob sidecars included. adding more nodes and validating the rate. <@654267572107083777> I'm seeing this error on the nimbus nodes regarding mev: ``` INF 2023-10-27 13:07:24.222+00:00 Payload builder error topics="beacval" slot=30037 head=7a23ad03:30036 validator=ab8da50b err="getBlindedExecutionPayload REST decoding error: Unable to decode REST response, error [Serialization error]" ``` `ssh devops@157.230.62.250` to check Killing devnet 9 now! checking the version tested there is probably missing one or both of https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/5522 and https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/pull/5526 which fix some necessary REST serialization for the `BlindedBlobsBundle` which is patr of the `BuilderBid` which is part of the `SignedBuilderBid` both already part of Nimbus `unstable` ah got it, should i update nimbus nodes to the latest `unstable` then? yes qq: are all clients ipv6 ready? https://notes.ethereum.org/@ethpandaops/dencun-devnet-11 Lighthouse is (<https://lighthouse-book.sigmaprime.io/advanced_networking.html#ipv6-support>)
